subject: Kickoff: MedixSoft procurement evidence & PO flow
content:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medixsoft.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@medixsoft.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: MedixSoft procurement evidence & PO flow

Hi Lauren / Marissa —

Thanks for taking this forward. We're excited to move toward contract but our procurement group needs a short intake so they can open a PO and schedule a security review. Primary asks from MedixSoft procurement:

- SOC 2 report or AOC (last 12 months)
- ISO certificate (if available)
- External pen test attestation / letter (redacted is fine)
- Vendor master form and W-9 (or equivalent)
- Sample invoice template and PO terms (payment net30 preferred)

Can you confirm which of these you can provide and an estimated delivery date? Our legal team also wants to confirm data residency (US-only) and whether logs/audit exports are available on request.

We'd like to get these into our system by Friday 23 Jan to avoid pushing the procurement review to the next cycle. Let me know if you need a HubSpot record or if it's easier to exchange docs over Drive / DocuSign.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Procurement Lead — MedixSoft
procure@medixsoft.com

------------------------------------------------------------

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medixsoft.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MedixSoft procurement evidence & PO flow

Hi Daniel —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers below and a suggested checklist attached.

- SOC 2: We can provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II AOC (Q4 2025). Redacted version is available for procurement review.
- ISO: We hold ISO 27001 certificate; I can attach the cert and scope.
- Pen test: We have a third-party pen test attestation letter (redacted), and can provide a summary of findings.
- Vendor form / W-9: We can complete MedixSoft's vendor master form. I'll also attach our W-9.
- Invoice/PO: Sample invoice and our preferred billing contact included in the checklist. Standard payment terms are net30; we can accommodate net45 for initial PO if that helps.

Delivery timeline: I will upload the redacted SOC 2 AOC and the ISO cert to the Drive link below today. The pen-test letter and W-9 will be added by EOD tomorrow (Mon 19 Jan). If MedixSoft needs original unredacted SOC 2 under an NDA, we can support that as well — please advise.

Attachments included: MedixSoft_Security_Pack_v1.pdf (checklist + document manifest), RoPA_export.csv (sample audit export fields).

Drive for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C_medix_evidence
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/medixsoft

Next steps / asks for procurement team:
1) Confirm whether redacted SOC 2 is sufficient or if you require an NDA for the full report.
2) Confirm data residency requirement: US-only or any regional exceptions for backups/log retention.
3) Share vendor master form (I can populate and return).

If helpful, I can schedule a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the checklist with your legal/procurement folks.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MedixSoft_Security_Pack_v1.pdf; RoPA_export.csv

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medixsoft.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@medixsoft.com, julia.ramos@medixsoft.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MedixSoft procurement evidence & PO flow

Thanks Lauren — this is great and aligns with what procurement needs. Two quick clarifications:

1) If you can do redacted SOC 2 first that will let us start the internal review. We have a standard mutual NDA template but procurement usually requests the vendor to provide it via DocuSign; would you prefer we send that or do you have your own?
2) For the PO we need a sample invoice and remit-to details (tax id + address). Can you attach a sample invoice PDF?

I'll loop in Julia Ramos from legal (cc'd) for any NDA questions. We aim to open the PO on Jan 22 if we have the redacted docs by Jan 20.

Thanks,
Daniel

Attachment: Initial_PO_requirements.pdf

------------------------------------------------------------

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medixsoft.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MedixSoft procurement evidence & PO flow

Hi all — looping in a couple technical / security notes from the infra side so MedixSoft has clear answers for legal: 

- Data residency: Redwood can guarantee customer data storage in US regions only for this account; backups replicated within US. We will note the account-level residency in the contract SOW.
- Audit exports: we can provide RoPA-style exports on request (sample CSV attached in Lauren's package). Retention windows and log export cadence are configurable — default 90 days for detailed logs, 365 days for aggregated billing telemetry.
- Pen-test letter: our pen-test attestation covers external-facing infra and common libraries. If MedixSoft requires scope expansion (e.g., additional app-level testing), we can run an engagement but it'll take ~4 weeks.

If procurement/legal would like a short technical attestation doc for the contract appendix I can draft one; please confirm the exact field names you need (e.g., "data location", "log retention period", "key management").

Grace — can you own coordinating the W-9 and vendor form fill?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

> On Jan 18, 2026 at 10:12 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Delivery timeline: I will upload the redacted SOC 2 AOC and the ISO cert to the Drive link below today. The pen-test letter and W-9 will be added by EOD tomorrow (Mon 19 Jan).

>

From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medixsoft.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MedixSoft procurement evidence & PO flow

Thanks Daniel — I'll take the vendor form and W-9 actions. Daniel, can you send your template vendor form to grace.oconnor@redwood.com? I'll complete and return the same day.

Also noted on the PO timelines — we'll aim to have everything uploaded to the Drive link by EOD 20 Jan so you have until close of day to open the PO. If you need DocuSign for the NDA, either route works for us; send the DocuSign link to lauren.bishop@redwood.com and neha.kapoor@redwood.com.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

---
Thread status: In progress — Redwood to upload redacted SOC 2 + ISO cert today, pen-test letter and W-9 by EOD 19 Jan. MedixSoft to confirm NDA route and provide vendor master form. PO target open date: 2026-01-22.
